stories.story_fr: Les ventes organiques ont reculé de 3% au premier semestre 2024.
Les ventes nettes organiques sont restées stables à -1% sur l'exercice 2024, +1% hors Russie.
stories.story_en: Organic net sales were stable at -1% for FY24, would be +1% excluding Russia.
stories.quote: organic net sales broadly stable at minus 1%

stories.story_fr: Performance très forte dans de nombreux marchés matures et émergents, compensant la normalisation aux États‑Unis et la faiblesse de la Chine.
stories.story_en: Very strong performance in many mature and emerging markets, offsetting US normalization and weak China.
stories.quote: Has a very strong performance in many mature and emerging markets, offset still normalizing United States and a weak China

stories.story_fr: Récupération séquentielle des volumes tout au long du second semestre de l'exercice 2024.
stories.story_en: Sequential volume recovery throughout the second half of FY24.
stories.quote: We've experienced sequential volume recovery throughout the second half of our fiscal year

stories.short: Margin expansion via pricing and cost discipline
stories.story_fr: Les prix, l'efficacité opérationnelle et la discipline des coûts ont entraîné une expansion de la marge brute et de la marge opérationnelle organiques.
stories.story_en: Pricing, operational efficiencies and cost discipline led to organic gross margin and operating margin expansion.
stories.quote: Pricing, operational efficiencies, and cost discipline have led to organic gross margin expansion and organic operating margin expansion
